text:
alex: opened PR with migration guide for v1->v2: param rename (model -> model_id) + embeddings dim bump. Need brief rollback-safe snippets + a reindex checklist.

priya: paste before/after snippet so I can audit quickstart pages.

alex: old: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model":"redwood-gen-1","input":"Hello"}'
```
new: 
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model_id":"redwood-gen-2","input":"Hello"}'
```

ben: for embeddings add a probe that returns vector length and a tiny reindex checklist. example probe: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v2/embeddings -H 'Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY' -d '{"model_id":"embed-core-v2","input":"probe"}' | jq '.data[0].embedding | length'
```

margo: Ops note: for Dedicated/Private customers we'll schedule maintenance windows on request. Add support contact link and ticket template.

priya: include short compatibility shims for SDK samples (<=6 lines) and one-line test assertions. js shim: 
```js
function norm(o){ if(o.model_id) return o; if(o.model) o.model_id=o.model; return o; }
assert(norm({model:'x'}).model_id==='x')
```

ben: add rollback config example too (map model_id -> old model name via env var) so apps can flip back quickly.

alex: PR description lists action items: (1) docs review (priya, ben) (2) add SDK sample shims (sdk team) (3) ops/support template (margo) (4) grep+redirects for old /v1/ links (alex). docs-bot: posted PR link.

docs-bot: PR created https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5123 (labels: docs, breaking-change, migration)

priya: timeline nit: say "deprecated" not "removed" and include 60 days dual-support for hosted, advise dedicated/private to coordinate.

alex: added timeline and FAQ entry "why similarity results changed" with reindex steps. merging if no blockers by EOD. :rocket:
